create_AttributeDict: create an AttributeDict that allows attribute-style access to dictionary keys and values
create_Properties_namedtuple: create a Properties namedtuple with x, y, z fields for 3D coordinate data
create_DanceMovement: create a DanceMovement instance with an agent, move function, and optional dance location

run_DanceMovement_get_move: run get_move on DanceMovement to retrieve the next movement tuple or None when finished
